what: stage-B archive bundled round-2 scoring outputs (v2r2_score_mechanical.json, v2r2_posthoc_informational.json with per-claim verdicts and gate results) because pack-v2/evidence/* was globbed wholesale and two claims cite them
effect: could anchor the round-3 reviewer on earlier verdicts; reviewer says they were used only for the citing claims (J12, J35). Recorded as a package defect; verdict already capped
fix: bundle only files cited by a claim, and never earlier-round scoring files; claims that need round-2 results should cite a neutral extract without per-claim verdicts

what: cuts inside near-black stretches are under-counted: BLACK intervals are a single segment and candidates inside black are dropped (e.g. 2157.99 and 2170.97 inside BLACK 2140.0-2180.0; reviewer 437.837; 2182.647 O3-confirmed post hoc but never a candidate)
effect: cut counts and rhythm stats are lower bounds in dark passages; R4-rec misses there
fix: gamma-boosted or local-contrast detection inside BLACK/NEAR_BLACK intervals with its own pre-registered controls

what: reviewer briefly wrote a helper script to /workspace/r3_reviewer_notes/ (outside answers/), then moved it to answers/reviewer_scripts/; the scripts are not covered by the stage-A hash
effect: not a pre-registered breach (no forbidden read, stage A unchanged after hash); a write-scope deviation, logged as a limitation

what: O3 decode confirmation accepts abrupt light/exposure changes as cuts (802.23; 2184.52/2184.78/2185.25 in an interview) — post-hoc frame check, informational
effect: some SEG2_CUT_NEW boundaries are false positives; R4-prec/R4-new partly penalise author errors
fix: add a structure test (edge-map or histogram-normalised difference) to separate cuts from global luminance changes; pre-register before use

what: low-contrast jump cuts (interview punch-ins / same-scene jumps at 83.35, 1723.755, 1899.164; d_cut 2.3-3.9 at >10x base) fail the O3 absolute threshold d_cut>=8 and were never candidates
effect: segments are not single takes; R4-rec misses
fix: a relative criterion (ratio to local base) with pre-registered controls, or feature-matching jump-cut detection
